svg.title: Western blot
svg.desc: Western blot membrane with sample lanes, molecular-weight ladder, realistic bands, lane labels, and loading control. Biological basis: Immunoblot band position estimates molecular mass and band intensity reflects target abundance only after appropriate loading normalization.
